# Does DORA reach you, what is still open, and when is the incident report due?

> Free EU DORA checker for financial entities and the software vendors that sell to them: whether Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 reaches you, which duty areas and Article 30 contract terms are still open, and the 4-hour, 72-hour and one-month major-incident report deadlines. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
